zh.title: 德國 AeroForce X 偵察機完成首飛 無人飛行測試時程未定
zh.summary: Aerodata 的 AeroForce X 原型機完成有人駕駛首飛，目標續航40小時，後續將逐步測試無人操作。
body: 德國 Aerodata 的 AeroForce X 偵察機原型機11月14日在布蘭登堡邦施特勞斯貝格機場完成首飛，開始飛行測試。此次由飛行員在機上操作；公司表示，操控、穩定性及關鍵系統測試均達成目標。
AeroForce X 定位為中高度長滯空無人航空系統，翼展26公尺，目標酬載能力為1.3公噸、續航最長40小時。這些數字是研發目標，並非此次首飛已驗證的性能。
公司規劃先進行更多有人駕駛飛行及自動駕駛測試，再展開首次無人飛行，目前尚未公佈日期。預定用途包括海上關鍵基礎設施監控等軍事及安全任務，模組化設計可搭載不同偵察設備。

en.title: Aerodata AeroForce X completes piloted maiden flight; unmanned test date unannounced
en.summary: The AeroForce X prototype has begun flight testing with a pilot on board, targeting up to 40 hours of endurance.
body: Germany’s Aerodata completed the maiden flight of its AeroForce X prototype at Strausberg Airport in Brandenburg on November 14. A pilot was on board. The company said tests of handling, stability and key systems met their objectives.

The aircraft is being developed as a medium-altitude, long-endurance unmanned system with a 26-metre wingspan. Its targets include a payload of up to 1.3 tonnes and endurance of up to 40 hours; these are development goals rather than performance demonstrated by this flight.

Further piloted flights and autopilot testing will precede unmanned operations. Aerodata has not announced a date for the first unpiloted flight. Intended military and security missions include surveillance of critical maritime infrastructure, using a modular design for different reconnaissance equipment.
